# Donalyze

> Hear a song, tip the artist directly on-chain. Donalyze records a short audio sample, identifies the track, and lets listeners send PAS tips to Spotify artists on Polkadot Hub TestNet.

## What this app does
- Records up to 15 seconds of audio in the browser.
- Identifies the track through Shazam-compatible audio recognition.
- Resolves Spotify artists and opens a multi-artist donation flow.
- Sends donations through the Donate Solidity contract on Polkadot Hub TestNet (chain 420420417).
- Lets artists claim an artist ID with a platform-signed EIP-712 authorisation and withdraw tips.

## Main routes
- / — discover a track and tip artists
- /claim — artist claim and payout flow
- /donations — on-chain donation history
- /statistics — platform metrics
- /about — product context

## Public API
- POST /api/discover — multipart audio file (audio/*, max 10 MB)
- GET /api/artist?artistUrl= — Spotify artist lookup
- GET /api/artists?ids= — up to 50 Spotify artist IDs
- GET /api/track?uri= — Spotify track lookup
- GET /api/verify?artistId=&claimant= — bio verification + EIP-712 claim authorisation
- POST /api/rpc — read-only Polkadot Hub JSON-RPC proxy

## Contract
- Source: contracts/src/Donate.sol
- Network: Polkadot Hub TestNet (420420417)
- Currency: PAS
- Explorer: https://blockscout-testnet.polkadot.io
- Claims: EIP-712 signed, bound to artist ID, claimant, and deadline.

## Agent notes
- Prefer /api endpoints over scraping the UI.
- Do not attempt to claim an artist ID without a valid EIP-712 signature from the platform signer.
- Donations are irreversible on-chain.
